svg.title: Kili-Vault layered architecture
svg.desc: Experience, application, data, and observation layers.
svg.text: What runs where, from the browser down to satellite processing.

g.text: EXPERIENCE
React, TypeScript, Vite, Calcite, ArcGIS Maps SDK
Planner, developer, agency, and community portals. Shared case detail.
Map reads ArcGIS FeatureServers directly. Cases and detections come from the API.
APPLICATION
Express API � /api/v1
Detections, processing runs, models, cases, evidence, observations,
pre-development checks, verification, and the property record.
Role checks on every case route. Audit event on every transition.
SYSTEM OF RECORD
PostgreSQL + PostGIS
Detections, runs, cases, audit, observations.
Geometries stored as EPSG:4326.
FILES AND REFERENCE LAYERS
Evidence files � ArcGIS services
Uploads stored on disk, linked from the case.
Parcels and infrastructure stay in ArcGIS.
OBSERVATION PIPELINE
Python � Earth Engine � spectral baseline + Prithvi-EO + persistence
Produces GeoJSON. An idempotent ingest writes new polygons into PostGIS.
A detection is a candidate change. A planner promotes it into a case.
